value.stringValue: Vegetation clearance shall take place outside breeding season for birds (March - September). Where this is not possible, a suitably qualified person should survey the areas prior to any works commencing. If nesting birds are found to be present, the works shall cease until young have fledged.
For the protection of flora and fauna and compliance with the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended), and with the Conservation of Species and Habitats Regulations 2017.

During the Development, the Applicant shall adhere to all recommendations outlined in section [section number] of the [report title] report issued by [official title of ecology company] on [date] (reference: [report reference]).
For the protection of flora and fauna and compliance with the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended), and with the Conservation of Species and Habitats Regulations 2017.
During the Development, the Company shall adhere to all conditions outlined in the Scheduled Monument Consent issued by Historic England/Cadw in [date] (reference: [ref number]).
To avoid damage to the legally protected Scheduled Monument and comply with consent under Section 2 of the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Areas Act 1979 (as amended).

The Development shall be carried out between [dates] in accordance with unconditional/conditional assent issued by Natural England/Natural Resources Wales on [date] (reference: [ref number]). The Development shall not be carried out out with the aforementioned dates without further consultation with Natural England.
To comply with assent of Natural England under Section 28H of The Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended).

The Development shall not commence until all required land rights are agreed and in place. The Company shall confirm in writing to the Secretary of State that all wayleave permissions have been granted and the Development shall not commence until permission is granted in writing by the Secretary of State.
To comply with Schedule 8 of the 1989 Act

During the Development, the Company shall adhere to the relevant provisions of the National Joint Utilities Group (NJUG) guidelines, particularly those in Volume 4 relating to utility works near trees.
